archive.security_status_cs: Vláda premiérky Sanae Takaiči čelí tlaku po náhlé rezignaci ministra zemědělství kvůli skandálu uprostřed klíčových parlamentních debat. Mezitím geopolitické napětí roste v důsledku zatčení japonského novináře v Rusku a plánů na posílení kontroly pozemků v okolí vojenských základen SDF.
archive.security_status_en: Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi's administration faces pressure following the abrupt resignation of the scandal-hit agriculture minister amid key parliamentary debates. Meanwhile, geopolitical tensions rise due to the arrest of a Japanese journalist in Russia and plans to tighten land controls near SDF military bases.

archive.forecast_en: Over the coming days, heightened Japanese market volatility can be expected due to global tech shocks and political negotiations following the minister's resignation. The yen exchange rate will continue to react sensitively to safe-haven demand.

Domácí trhy zároveň sledují opatrný návrat MUFG k japonským státním dluhopisům kvůli rizikům spojeným s měnovou a fiskální politikou.
archive.security_status_en: The Japanese yen strengthened due to increased global demand for safe havens following tech sector shocks triggered by China's DeepSeek model. Meanwhile, domestic markets are closely monitoring MUFG's cautious return to Japanese government bonds amid risks related to monetary and fiscal policies.

archive.forecast_en: Over the coming days, the yen exchange rate will continue to benefit from its safe-haven status, while the domestic bond market remains monitored due to yield pressures.

Trhy mezitím silně reagují na globální technologický výprodej vyvolaný americkou inflací a obavami kolem AI, což katapultovalo kurz jenu jako bezpečného přístavu vzhůru.

archive.forecast_en: Over the coming days, the yen exchange rate will continue to benefit from its safe-haven status amid global volatility, while equities will seek a price floor following the recent sell-off.

archive.forecast_en: Over the coming days, the yen exchange rate will continue to benefit from its safe-haven status amid persistent global volatility, while Japanese equities will attempt to stabilize following the recent sharp decline.
